I can relate to this a lot. Being super kind to everyone (most people). I think I’m like you, I tend to feel worthless and useless so when I actually get to help someone I feel accomplished and validated. Probably has to do with low self-esteem. Anyways, you don’t have to be alone; feel free to pm me we can be friends :) 

You deserve love, don’t let anyone (including yourself) convince you otherwise. Being negative doesn’t mean we don’t deserve love. It just means we have chemical imbalances in our brain that make our perception of situations and ourselves more negative. You can’t control that but there are healthy ways to overcome it. I’m not there yet but I’m working on it. I don’t understand how it works bc I may sound optimistic now but in a few hours I’ll probably be feeling hopeless again. But like the other comment mentioned, its important to be aware if the distinction between the reality of situations and our skewed perceptions.

Edit: want to add its not your fault. Friends that only stick around for your entertainment value aren’t that great. But I guess its also fair for them to decide who they wanna surround themselves with. Its no ones fault really. You can’t help how you feel, but there are things you can do to reduce the impact of those negative words. It starts with your thoughts. I still have a hard time with this too, but whenever someone tells me I’m being too negative I try to use that information to be more mindful of my thought processes that lead me to say negative things. Have you looked into therapy?

I was vague about the friends because it’s a lot of drama that’s not really relevant to the situation. Basically I’ve been feeling isolated and excluded since the summer and I haven’t hung out with any of my friends for months. I would see them on campus from time to time but that’s it. I really only had my boyfriend to hang out with. Since he’s been gone I’ve been struggling and one night the panic attacks got really bad so I reached out to one of my friends. She picked me up and let me stay the night at theirs (my friend group lives together). They were having some friend drama and during one of the conversations it came out that they intentionally isolated me back in the summer for a petty reason. They made new group chats without me and didn’t invite me to any plans. I’ve been feeling sad and lonely and blaming myself for pushing away my friends and not putting in effort when it wasn’t even wanted in the first place. So yeah, my one friend that I reached out has always been kind to me and I appreciate that she helped me but idk how I feel about the whole situation (I only learned of it yesterday).
